Combined with C4 NGAP shrinkage and C8 PE 0603216F two-year zero, the entire AF adaptive/advanced-engine RDT&E envelope is being squeezed in FY26
scores.interpretation: PE 0604004F was funded $270M FY24 and $100M FY25; the FY26 PB zeros it. Per heuristic 1, UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR maps to SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY. While GE Aerospace did NOT name 0604004F in the filing, the 10-K's forward 'significant ramp in delivery of engine units' narrative depends on the AF advanced-engine pipeline. This is the kind of structural funding loss the framework is built to surface — a coherent program-element trio (0604004F + 0603216F + 0604010F) all moving the wrong direction simultaneously while the issuer's narrative remains bullish.
